description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Affiliate' within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class handles email notifications related to affiliate accounts, including sending welcome emails and alerts, by loading relevant models, language files, and templates, and scheduling email tasks.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling affiliate-related email notifications in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Send a welcome email to the new affiliate and schedule the email as a task.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Send alert notifications to configured email addresses when an affiliate account is created or updated, based on configuration settings.
